question: Which woman, husband, and tree are exalted as supreme exemplars of fidelity and kingship?
premises: Arundhati is foremost and the lord devoted to one wife is supreme.
The sacred fig tree is indeed the king of all trees.
inference: Arundhati, the one-wife lord, and the sacred fig tree are presented as supreme exemplars.
uncertainties: ekapatnīśo may refer to Rama as the ideal husband devoted to one wife
plain_english: Arundhati is foremost, the lord devoted to one wife is supreme, and indeed the sacred fig tree is the king of all trees.
